2607.17806.title: PGN: Design and Implementation of a Vision-Language Navigation System Based on Pangu Multimodal Foundation Model
2607.17806.paper_summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to interpret a natural-language instruction and predict actions from temporally ordered visual observations. Adapting a multimodal large language model to VLN requires visual-language alignment, compact temporal inputs, action-space grounding, and stable training on the target hardware. This technical report presents PGN (Pangu Navigator), an offline VLN action-prediction system built on OpenPangu-7B. Training proceeds in two stages. First, PGMM aligns a frozen EVA-ViT-G/14 vision encoder with the frozen language backbone by training a Q-Former and a two-layer MLP projector. Second, PGN adapts the aligned model to expert navigation trajectories using five-observation windows, epoch-dependent temporal sampling, and a reasoning-then-action output format; this stage freezes the aligned visual pathway and updates three structural-token embeddings and LoRA adapters. The implementation combines mixed-precision computation, selective FP32 computation, and DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 on eight Ascend 910B NPUs. Under teacher-forced, open-loop evaluation on 500 held-out expert trajectories, V9 reports a 62.29% Normalized Action Match (NAM) and a 100.00% Non-empty Rate (NER). These metrics quantify offline expert-action alignment rather than closed-loop navigation success; evaluating error accumulation, path efficiency, and goal completion remains future work.
2607.17806.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言導航（VLN）需要一個具身的代理來解釋自然語言指令並根據時間排序的視覺觀察預測行動。將多模態大型語言模型調整為VLN需要視覺-語言對齊、緊湊的時間輸入、行動空間的基礎以及在目標硬體上的穩定訓練。這份技術報告介紹了PGN（Pangu Navigator），這是一個基於OpenPangu-7B的離線VLN行動預測系統。訓練分為兩個階段。首先，PGMM通過訓練一個Q-Former和一個兩層的MLP投影器，將凍結的EVA-ViT-G/14視覺編碼器與凍結的語言主幹對齊。其次，PGN使用五個觀察窗口、依訓練週期的時間取樣和推理-然後-行動的輸出格式，將對齊的模型調整為專家導航軌跡；這一階段凍結了對齊的視覺通道並更新了三個結構標記嵌入和LoRA適配器。該實現結合了混合精度計算、選擇性FP32計算和DeepSpeed ZeRO-2，在八個Ascend 910B NPU上進行。根據教師強迫的開放循環評估，在500條保留的專家軌跡上，V9報告了62.29%的標準化行動匹配（NAM）和100.00%的非空率（NER）。這些指標量化了離線專家行動的對齊，而不是閉環導航的成功；評估錯誤累積、路徑效率和目標完成仍然是未來的工作。
